sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 767 physical subject rows / 752 family-card identities across 23 sections are reconciled. Fifteen second signers retain their preceding printed partnership code for grouping and their original blank code cells. All 300 base numbers remain split into Common, Uncommon and Rare; (xB) EXPECTED BRILLIANCE is its own 40-card program. Names, original club spellings, Charlize Theron’s blank club and 156 literal Rookie marks are preserved. LeBron James’s On-Card annotation is separate from Rookie. All 115 odds values retain their original PL FINEST 2026 product-title column; the sheet names neither format nor ratio unit. The six common-insert group rows remain unjoined because the five themes are unnamed; seven 1996/97 odds rows remain separate from the checklist’s 1995/96 program. Only the named FP-SM 1/1 dual example and FS-IW five-copy red example receive card-specific guide statements, with no inferred parallel names or family-wide serial limits. April 23 store availability is not a verified general release date. Other numbering and exhaustive parallel coverage remain unverified.
Source headings are descriptive adapter labels. Published annotation preserves both Rookie and On-Card; the Rookie filter uses only literal Rookie marks.
Six COMMON INSERTS (FIVE THEMES) categories do not name their five roster themes. Preserve those aggregate odds separately; do not infer exact family aliases from the number of insert rosters.
The checklist and guide name Finest Seasons 1995/96, while seven odds categories print FINEST SEASONS - 1996/97. Preserve both year labels and leave their odds join unresolved.

The two checked numbering examples remain card-specific. The FP-SM guide does not name its 1/1 parallel; FS-IW is a five-copy red color-match example without an explicit serial-number statement. Neither establishes a family-wide numbering ladder.
PL FINEST 2026 is the product-title odds column, not a named pack format. No ratio unit is stated. Product-page Hobby contents do not turn those ratios, including 2:1, into per-pack rates.
April 23 store availability and April 21 / April 28 guide publication dates do not establish a general calendar release date. Exhaustive parallel coverage and other numbering remain unverified.
